scale.source: CLDR RBNF, common/rbnf/el.xml (unicode-org/cldr, cldrVersion 50): δισεκατομμύριο is 10^9 and τρισεκατομμύριο 10^12; each Greek scale word has one fixed value.

group_mark.source: CLDR main/el.xml, latn number symbols: group ".".

decimal_mark.source: CLDR main/el.xml, latn number symbols: decimal ",".

space_groups.source: CLDR main/el.xml groups digits with ".", not a space.

plural_scale_needs_count.source: CLDR RBNF, common/rbnf/el.xml (unicode-org/cldr, cldrVersion 50): 2000 is "<< χιλιάδες", a count before the plural; "χιλιάδες" alone names no number.

scale_noun_agrees.source: CLDR RBNF, common/rbnf/el.xml (unicode-org/cldr, cldrVersion 50): "1000000: <%spellout-cardinal-neuter< $(cardinal,one{εκατομμύριο}other{εκατομμύρια})$": the count one takes the singular, any other count the plural.

joiner_tens_units.source: CLDR RBNF, common/rbnf/el.xml (unicode-org/cldr, cldrVersion 50): "20: είκοσι[ >>]", the unit follows the ten after a space.

joiner_after_hundred.source: CLDR RBNF, common/rbnf/el.xml (unicode-org/cldr, cldrVersion 50): "100: εκατό[ν >>]", no "και" after the hundreds.

joiner_between_groups.source: CLDR RBNF, common/rbnf/el.xml (unicode-org/cldr, cldrVersion 50): "1000: χίλιοι[ >>]" puts no "και" between groups; the title "Χίλιες και μία νύχτες" shows the older "και" before a last unit.

joiner_before_round_hundred.source: CLDR RBNF, common/rbnf/el.xml (unicode-org/cldr, cldrVersion 50): "1000: χίλια[ >>]": no "και" after a thousand; the older "και" stands before a last unit only.

ordinal_style.source: CLDR RBNF, common/rbnf/el.xml (unicode-org/cldr, cldrVersion 50): "20: εικοστός[ >>]", every word of an ordinal is ordinal ("εικοστός πρώτος").

fold_marks.source: Greek marks the stressed syllable with the tonos (Holton et al.), so a word with an accent is read as written: "εκτός" (except) is no "έκτος" (sixth). A word typed with no accent at all, as in capitals or quick typing ("εικοσι ενα"), is read without its marks.

joiner.source: Λεξικό της κοινής νεοελληνικής (Ίδρυμα Μανόλη Τριανταφυλλίδη), entry "και"; "ένα και μισό" is one and a half.

minus.source: CLDR RBNF, common/rbnf/el.xml (unicode-org/cldr, cldrVersion 50): "-x: μείον >>"; Λεξικό της κοινής νεοελληνικής (Ίδρυμα Μανόλη Τριανταφυλλίδη), entry "πλην": minus in arithmetic.

range_cue.source: Λεξικό της κοινής νεοελληνικής (Ίδρυμα Μανόλη Τριανταφυλλίδη), entry "μεταξύ": between; in "μεταξύ Α και Β" the "και" joins the two limits.

article_one.source: Holton, Mackridge, Philippaki-Warburton, Greek: A Comprehensive Grammar of the Modern Language (Routledge), chapter on numerals: the indefinite article has the forms of the numeral "one".
